_readme: The issue catalogue (backlog-issues B12, owner decisions D11 and D12). Every error a person can meet: a permanent number, the stable code the frontend switches on (never shown), and plain words. A new issue takes the next free number; a retired number is never reused. Copied into the `issue` table by migration: a change here needs a migration declaring its ISSUES_FINGERPRINT (tests/test_issue_catalogue.py).
